Web map of Manitoba's forest boundaries in 2021. This web map is used within Manitoba's Five Year Report on the Status of Forestry, 2016 - 2021 story map.  
  
  Web map of Manitoba's forest boundaries in 2021. This web map is used within Manitoba's Five Year Report on the Status of Forestry, 2016 - 2021 story map.  The forest boundaries included represent forest sections, forest management units, provincial forests and forest management license areas.
